summary: 5 candidates: 2 adopt (mcp url transport, sessionStart->kbd-status), 1 defer (stdio shim), 2 reject (npx third-party servers, shipping binaries in-package). The assessment's blocking PATH prerequisite is RESOLVED: kimi-cu ships a shim whose header states the vendor rule verbatim, and 3 of 4 vendor packages use the url form, which sidesteps PATH entirely. change-kde-001 is unblocked.
key_verdicts: ADOPT url-form mcpServers for surreal-memory and prometheus-knowledge
DEFER stdio shims (both binaries already on PATH)
REJECT shipping binaries into the plugin package (payload-bloat lesson, 188M->98M)
BLOCKED: forge-rs returned 401 and the vendor url schema shows no auth-header field
open_questions: Can a url-form server requiring a bearer token be used at all from Kimi Desktop?
Do hooks / systemPrompt fire on the daimon? Still unproven.
Is there a catalog/description budget at 145 skills?
review_warnings: skillInstructions still has no explicit adopt/reject decision despite goal 2 requiring one per extension point — carried from the assess handoff unresolved.
kbd-status was verified present on disk only; its SUITABILITY as a sessionStart payload is unverified.
The url-form adopt verdict rests on vendor packages whose target runtime (desktop daimon vs CLI) is never established.
HTTP 200/405 proves a listener exists, NOT that the endpoint speaks MCP. Spec must verify an actual MCP handshake before emitting these.
SUGGESTION: investigate how the vendor's own authenticated url servers (github, supabase) handle credentials before concluding bearer-token servers are unusable.
SUGGESTION: adopted url integrations hardcode localhost ports 23001/8942 with no reinstall-durability argument, which goal 4 requires.
